cases.why: positive control: the reference artifact solve.sh builds from the captured main.rs passes all three functions
no data.comp: every function asserts on existence
the uncompressed text as data.comp: exists, does not round-trip, too large
tamper: /app/data.txt and /app/decomp.c replaced before grading; setup() restores both from /tests, so tampering cannot help or hurt
the reference cut to 2000 bytes: under the size wall but the stream ends early
the reference plus 300 zero bytes: the decoder stops before the padding, so it round-trips but breaks the 2500-byte wall
an empty data.comp exists and is small but decodes to nothing useful

one byte of the reference inverted: same size, corrupted stream. Mechanism predicted F (mismatch); dry runs 1-3 observed the grader's own subprocess.run(text=True) raising UnicodeDecodeError on the corrupted output, so the round-trip function errors instead of failing its assertion
